title: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
slides: Why is Firefox betting on an AI browser?
Smart Window launches with form filling built in
It also watches webpages in ways users may not expect
Your existing Firefox gets these features automatically
Check your settings before the next update lands
thread_text:
1. Firefox's AI gamble

Mozilla is integrating AI directly into the browser, starting with automatic form filling. Your existing Firefox will get these features whether you opt in or not.

2. Smart Window's quiet debut

The new feature doesn't just fill forms—it actively watches how you browse, tracking patterns you might not realize you're revealing.

3. The update nobody asked for

There's no separate download or beta flag. The next Firefox update pushes these capabilities to every user by default.

4. Settings you need to check

Before the update lands, review your privacy controls. The AI's webpage monitoring may already be enabled in your current build.

5. Your move before the rollout

Open Firefox settings now and search for 'AI features.' Toggle off anything you didn't explicitly turn on—then decide if you trust the defaults.
video_script: Firefox is putting AI right inside your browser.
It fills forms automatically and watches pages quietly.
Your current Firefox will get this without asking.
Check your settings before the next update arrives.
Would you trust a browser that watches you back?
